settings.locale.reload.en: Reload a website to apply its new language. Website account settings may override browser preferences.
settings.locale.reload.zh: 保存后刷新网页以应用新配置。网站账号设置可能覆盖浏览器的语言偏好。

settings.privacy.description.en: Restricts common document-level canvas, WebGL, audio and font fingerprint reads. Worker and cross-frame fingerprint resistance is not guaranteed. Some sites may not work. Claude, Anthropic, Gemini, Google sign-in and challenges.cloudflare.com use compatibility exceptions for verification. Network privacy protections remain active. It does not hide your account, cookies, IP address or every possible fingerprint.
settings.privacy.description.zh: 限制常见网页 Canvas、WebGL、音频和字体指纹读取；不保证覆盖 Worker 和跨框架读取，部分网站可能受限。Claude、Anthropic、Gemini、Google 登录和官方 Cloudflare 验证域名使用兼容例外，网络防护仍开启。账号、Cookie、出口 IP 和其他指纹仍可能识别用户。

settings.privacy.dnsDescription.en: When Chromium resolves a hostname it uses encrypted DNS. Website names are resolved through DoH before proxy tunneling. Proxy-side traffic inspection or DNS rules may still affect observed results. Cloudflare receives DNS queries. If DoH is unreachable, name resolution may fail.
settings.privacy.dnsDescription.zh: 浏览器先通过加密 DoH 解析域名，再建立代理隧道。代理端流量嗅探或规则仍可能影响结果。Cloudflare 会接收 DNS 查询；DoH 不可用时解析会失败。
